value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks cooler. Partly sunny with a high around 65°F, and clouds build later. There's a 30% chance of rain after 3 p.m., with showers possibly moving in Tuesday evening. Lows Tuesday night drop into the 30s and low 40s, and winds are north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph.
